title: Rustam's Fourth Course, He Cleaves a Witch
creator: Painting attributed to Qadimi; text by Abu'l Qasim Firdausi
shelfmark: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1970.301.17; fol. 120v
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York; Gift of Arthur A. Houghton Jr., 1970. Resized and converted to WebP; full composition retained.
description: An early-sixteenth-century Iranian illustration of an episode in Firdausi's Shahnama. The sword belongs to a legendary narrative, not an eyewitness record of the ancient events.
relation: An example of sword imagery in Persian manuscript painting. It does not establish an Arabian or Ottoman identity for the supplied curved-sword model.

relation: A historical comparison for sword mountings. The supplied dragon katana is fantasy artwork, not a reproduction of this object.
